verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is an open-source CLI secrets scanner run locally/self-hosted with no evidence of any telemetry or phone-home behavior; the evidence pack (probe-7) confirms it runs fully headlessly without an account or API key, and there's no mention of any usage-tracking mechanism at all. Since no telemetry collection is claimed or evidenced, opting out is a category error for this local CLI tool's core OSS use case.
